summary: Hierarchical list (role="treegrid") for folders, categories, permissions, or org charts, with expansion, type-to-search, and optional checkbox selection.
whenToUse: Nested structures explorable across multiple levels.
Selecting nodes in a hierarchy (permissions, categories).
whenNotToUse: Main site navigation: use Sidebar or NavigationMenu.
A single level: use a list or Accordion.
Tabular data with columns: use DataTable.

props.name: onAction
props.description: Action on a node (Enter, double-click with replace).

props.name: TreeViewItem textValue
props.description: Text used for search; required if title is not a string.

inherits: Props of react-aria-components Tree and TreeItem (items with a render function, href, renderEmptyState…).

keyboard.action: Expands / collapses (reversed in RTL); on an already expanded node, → moves into its children.

accessibility: Built on react-aria-components Tree: aria-level, aria-expanded, aria-selected, and a single tab stop.
The expand button has a name localized by react-aria; icons are hidden from assistive technologies.
The expanded state is indicated by the arrow rotation, not by color.
responsive: Per-level indentation is compact; with many levels, place the tree in a ScrollArea to avoid page-wide horizontal overflow.
commonMistakes: Loading thousands of fully expanded nodes: expand on demand.
limits: No built-in lazy loading of children: handle it in the consumer by updating items in onExpandedChange.
